11171:     def get_candidate_model_ids_for_route(self, model: str, team_id: str | None = None) -> frozenset[str]:
11172:         """
11173:         Deployment ids that could serve ``model`` for ``team_id``, unioned across the paths
11174:         the router resolves a route through: ``model_group_alias``, a routing group, the
11175:         ``model_name`` and team indexes, and wildcard pattern routes. Read-only and
11176:         side-effect-free, unlike ``_common_checks_available_deployment`` which also applies
11177:         fallbacks and can raise. Lets a pre-call check tell a genuine cross-group route from
11178:         same-group unavailability without re-deriving that precedence at the call site, and
11179:         without leaking deployment ids into request kwargs bound for the provider.
11180:         """
11181:         resolved: Final = self._get_model_from_alias(model=model) or model
11182:         routing_group_members: Final = self._get_routing_group_deployments(model=resolved, team_id=team_id)
11183:         if routing_group_members is not None:
11184:             return self._deployment_ids(routing_group_members)
11185:         if resolved in self.model_names:
11186:             return self._deployment_ids(self._get_all_deployments(model_name=resolved, team_id=team_id))
11187:         team_router: Final = self.team_pattern_routers.get(team_id) if team_id is not None else None
11188:         return self._deployment_ids(
11189:             (
11190:                 *self._get_all_deployments(model_name=resolved, team_id=team_id),
11191:                 # ``get_deployments_by_pattern`` (not bare ``route``) is the router's
11192:                 # resolution: it also tries the provider-qualified spelling, so an
11193:                 # unprefixed request name matches a wildcard deployment such as
11194:                 # ``openai/*`` the same way ``_common_checks_available_deployment``
11195:                 # would route it.
11196:                 *self.pattern_router.get_deployments_by_pattern(resolved),
11197:                 *((team_router.get_deployments_by_pattern(resolved) or ()) if team_router is not None else ()),
11198:             )
11199:         )

11336:     def _get_all_deployments(
11337:         self,
11338:         model_name: str,
11339:         model_alias: str | None = None,
11340:         team_id: str | None = None,
11341:     ) -> list[DeploymentTypedDict]:
11342:         """
11343:         Return all deployments of a model name
11344: 
11345:         Used for accurate 'get_model_list'.
11346: 
11347:         if team_id specified, only return team-specific models
11348: 
11349:         Optimized with O(1) index lookup instead of O(n) linear scan.
11350: 
11351:         Note: when team_id is provided, O(1) lookup in
11352:         `team_model_to_deployment_indices` only applies when `model_name` is the
11353:         team public model name. If a caller passes an internal deployment model
11354:         name (for example, `model_name_<team_id>_<uuid>`), this method falls back
11355:         to the standard model-name index / scan path.
11356:         """
11357:         returned_models: Final[list[DeploymentTypedDict]] = []
11358: 
11359:         # O(1) lookup in team_model index when team_id is provided
11360:         if team_id is not None:
11361:             key: Final = (team_id, model_name)
11362:             if key in self.team_model_to_deployment_indices:
11363:                 indices = self.team_model_to_deployment_indices[key]
11364:                 # O(k) where k = team deployments for this model_name (typically 1-10)
11365:                 for idx in indices:
11366:                     model = self.model_list[idx]
11367:                     if not self.should_include_deployment(model_name=model_name, model=model, team_id=team_id):
11368:                         continue
11369:                     if model_alias is not None:
11370:                         alias_model = model.copy()
11371:                         alias_model["model_name"] = model_alias
11372:                         returned_models.append(alias_model)
11373:                     else:
11374:                         returned_models.append(model)
11375:                 if returned_models:
11376:                     return returned_models
11377: 
11378:         # O(1) lookup in model_name index
11379:         if model_name in self.model_name_to_deployment_indices:
11380:             indices = self.model_name_to_deployment_indices[model_name]
11381: 
11382:             # O(k) where k = deployments for this model_name (typically 1-10)
11383:             for idx in indices:
11384:                 model = self.model_list[idx]
11385:                 if self.should_include_deployment(model_name=model_name, model=model, team_id=team_id):
11386:                     if model_alias is not None:
11387:                         # Optimized: Use shallow copy since we only modify top-level model_name
11388:                         # This is much faster than deepcopy for nested dict structures
11389:                         alias_model = model.copy()
11390:                         alias_model["model_name"] = model_alias
11391:                         returned_models.append(alias_model)
11392:                     else:
11393:                         returned_models.append(model)
11394:         elif team_id is not None:
11395:             # Fallback: if team_id is provided and model_name not in index,
11396:             # check if model_name matches any team_public_model_name
11397:             # O(n) scan but only when team_id lookup fails
11398:             for idx, model in enumerate(self.model_list):
11399:                 if self.should_include_deployment(model_name=model_name, model=model, team_id=team_id):
11400:                     if model_alias is not None:
11401:                         # Optimized: Use shallow copy since we only modify top-level model_name
11402:                         alias_model = model.copy()
11403:                         alias_model["model_name"] = model_alias
11404:                         returned_models.append(alias_model)
11405:                     else:
11406:                         returned_models.append(model)
11407: 
11408:         return returned_models

11731:     def get_model_list(
11732:         self, model_name: str | None = None, team_id: str | None = None
11733:     ) -> list[DeploymentTypedDict] | None:
11734:         """
11735:         Includes router model_group_alias'es as well
11736: 
11737:         if team_id specified, returns matching team-specific models
11738:         """
11739:         # Note: model_list and model_group_alias are always initialized in __init__
11740:         # so hasattr checks are unnecessary
11741:         returned_models: list[DeploymentTypedDict] = []
11742: 
11743:         if model_name is not None:
11744:             returned_models.extend(self._get_all_deployments(model_name=model_name, team_id=team_id))
11745: 
11746:         returned_models.extend(self.get_model_list_from_model_alias(model_name=model_name))
11747:         returned_models.extend(self.get_model_list_from_routing_groups(model_name=model_name))
11748: 
11749:         if len(returned_models) == 0:  # check if wildcard route
11750:             potential_wildcard_models: Final = self.pattern_router.get_deployments_by_pattern(model=model_name or "")
11751: 
11752:             ## check for team-specific wildcard models
11753:             if team_id is not None and team_id in self.team_pattern_routers:
11754:                 potential_team_only_wildcard_models: Final = self.team_pattern_routers[
11755:                     team_id
11756:                 ].get_deployments_by_pattern(model=model_name or "")
11757:                 potential_wildcard_models.extend(potential_team_only_wildcard_models)
11758: 
11759:             if model_name is not None and potential_wildcard_models is not None:
11760:                 for m in potential_wildcard_models:
11761:                     deployment_typed_dict = DeploymentTypedDict(**m)
11762:                     deployment_typed_dict["model_name"] = model_name
11763:                     returned_models.append(deployment_typed_dict)
11764: 
11765:         if model_name is None:
11766:             returned_models += self.model_list
11767: 
11768:         return returned_models

12326:     def _try_early_resolve_deployments_for_model_not_in_names(
12327:         self,
12328:         model: str,
12329:         request_team_id: str | None,
12330:         include_team_models: bool = False,
12331:     ) -> tuple[str, list | dict] | None:
12332:         """
12333:         When ``model`` is not in ``self.model_names``, try team routes, pattern routes,
12334:         team pattern routers, then default deployment. Returns None if none apply.
12335:         """
12336:         if model in self.model_names:
12337:             return None
12338:         # Check for team-specific deployments by team_public_model_name.
12339:         # This intentionally takes priority over team pattern routers below,
12340:         # so that named team deployments shadow wildcard/pattern routes.
12341:         if request_team_id is not None:
12342:             team_deployments = self._get_all_deployments(model_name=model, team_id=request_team_id)
12343:             if team_deployments:
12344:                 return model, team_deployments
12345:         elif include_team_models:
12346:             team_deployments = self._team_deployments_across_teams(model)
12347:             if team_deployments:
12348:                 return model, team_deployments
12349: 
12350:         pattern_deployments = self.pattern_router.get_deployments_by_pattern(
12351:             model=model,
12352:         )
12353: 
12354:         if pattern_deployments:
12355:             return model, pattern_deployments
12356: 
12357:         if request_team_id is not None and request_team_id in self.team_pattern_routers:
12358:             pattern_deployments = self.team_pattern_routers[request_team_id].get_deployments_by_pattern(
12359:                 model=model,
12360:             )
12361:             if pattern_deployments:
12362:                 return model, pattern_deployments
12363: 
12364:         if self.default_deployment is not None:
12365:             # Shallow copy with nested litellm_params copy (100x+ faster than deepcopy)
12366:             updated_deployment: Final = self.default_deployment.copy()
12367:             updated_deployment["litellm_params"] = self.default_deployment["litellm_params"].copy()
12368:             updated_deployment["litellm_params"]["model"] = model
12369:             return model, updated_deployment
12370: 
12371:         return None

12420:     def _common_checks_available_deployment(
12421:         self,
12422:         model: str,
12423:         messages: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None,
12424:         input: str | list | None = None,
12425:         specific_deployment: bool | None = False,
12426:         request_kwargs: dict | None = None,
12427:     ) -> tuple[str, list | dict]:
12428:         """
12429:         Common checks for 'get_available_deployment' across sync + async call.
12430: 
12431:         If 'healthy_deployments' returned is None, this means the user chose a specific deployment
12432: 
12433:         Returns
12434:         - str, the litellm model name
12435:         - List, if multiple models chosen
12436:         - Dict, if specific model chosen
12437:         """
12438: 
12439:         request_team_id: Final = get_request_team_id(request_kwargs)
12440:         # check if aliases set on litellm model alias map
12441:         if specific_deployment is True:
12442:             return model, self._get_deployment_by_litellm_model(model=model)
12443:         elif self.has_model_id(model):
12444:             deployment: Final = self.get_deployment(model_id=model)
12445:             if deployment is not None:
12446:                 deployment_model: Final = deployment.litellm_params.model
12447:                 return deployment_model, deployment.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
12448:             raise ValueError(
12449:                 f"LiteLLM Router: Trying to call specific deployment, but Model ID :{model} does not exist in Model ID map"
12450:             )
12451: 
12452:         _model_from_alias: Final = self._get_model_from_alias(model=model)
12453:         if _model_from_alias is not None:
12454:             model = _model_from_alias
12455: 
12456:         _routing_group_deployments: Final = self._get_routing_group_deployments(model=model, team_id=request_team_id)
12457:         if _routing_group_deployments is None:
12458:             early: Final = self._try_early_resolve_deployments_for_model_not_in_names(
12459:                 model=model,
12460:                 request_team_id=request_team_id,
12461:                 include_team_models=_is_proxy_admin_request(request_kwargs),
12462:             )
12463:             if early is not None:
12464:                 if not isinstance(early[1], list):
12465:                     return early
12466:                 return early[0], self._drop_strategy_markers(early[0], early[1])
12467: 
12468:         ## get healthy deployments
12469:         ### get all deployments
12470:         healthy_deployments = (
12471:             _routing_group_deployments
12472:             if _routing_group_deployments is not None
12473:             else self._get_all_deployments(model_name=model, team_id=request_team_id)
12474:         )
12475:         _pre_model_access_group_filter_len: Final = len(healthy_deployments)
12476:         healthy_deployments = self._filter_deployments_by_model_access_groups(
12477:             model=model,
12478:             healthy_deployments=healthy_deployments,
12479:             request_kwargs=request_kwargs,
12480:             request_team_id=request_team_id,
12481:         )
12482:         _access_group_filter_emptied_candidates = (
12483:             _pre_model_access_group_filter_len > 0 and len(healthy_deployments) == 0
12484:         )
12485: 
12486:         if len(healthy_deployments) == 0:
12487:             # check if the user sent in a deployment name instead
12488:             # Do not fall back when access-group filtering removed every candidate;
12489:             # _get_deployment_by_litellm_model does not re-apply that filter.
12490:             if _pre_model_access_group_filter_len == 0:
12491:                 _litellm_model_deployments: Final = self._get_deployment_by_litellm_model(model=model)
12492:                 healthy_deployments = self._filter_deployments_by_model_access_groups(
12493:                     model=model,
12494:                     healthy_deployments=_litellm_model_deployments,
12495:                     request_kwargs=request_kwargs,
12496:                     request_team_id=request_team_id,
12497:                 )
12498:                 # If the litellm-model lookup produced candidates that access-group
12499:                 # filtering then removed, treat this the same as the by-name path
12500:                 # being emptied: prevent default-model fallback from bypassing the
12501:                 # restriction (the fallback model may have no access_groups and
12502:                 # would short-circuit the filter).
12503:                 if len(_litellm_model_deployments) > 0 and len(healthy_deployments) == 0:
12504:                     _access_group_filter_emptied_candidates = True
12505: 
12506:         if verbose_router_logger.isEnabledFor(logging.DEBUG):
12507:             verbose_router_logger.debug("initial list of deployments: %s", healthy_deployments)
12508: 
12509:         if len(healthy_deployments) == 0:
12510:             # Check for default fallbacks if no deployments are found for the requested model
12511:             # Do not fall back to another model when access-group filtering removed every
12512:             # candidate for the requested name: re-filtering the fallback model can be a
12513:             # no-op when it has no access_groups, incorrectly serving a different model.
12514:             if self._has_default_fallbacks() and not _access_group_filter_emptied_candidates:
12515:                 fallback_model: Final = self._get_first_default_fallback()
12516:                 if fallback_model:
12517:                     verbose_router_logger.info(
12518:                         "Model '%s' not found. Attempting to use default fallback model '%s'.", model, fallback_model
12519:                     )
12520:                     # Re-assign model to the fallback and try to get deployments again
12521:                     model = fallback_model
12522:                     healthy_deployments = self._get_all_deployments(model_name=model, team_id=request_team_id)
12523:                     healthy_deployments = self._filter_deployments_by_model_access_groups(
12524:                         model=model,
12525:                         healthy_deployments=healthy_deployments,
12526:                         request_kwargs=request_kwargs,
12527:                         request_team_id=request_team_id,
12528:                     )
12529: 
12530:             # If still no deployments after checking for fallbacks, raise an error
12531:             if len(healthy_deployments) == 0:
12532:                 raise litellm.BadRequestError(
12533:                     message=f"You passed in model={model}. {RouterErrors.no_healthy_deployments.value}",
12534:                     model=model,
12535:                     llm_provider="",
12536:                 )
12537: 
12538:         if litellm.model_alias_map and model in litellm.model_alias_map:
12539:             model = litellm.model_alias_map[
12540:                 model
12541:             ]  # update the model to the actual value if an alias has been passed in
12542: 
12543:         return model, self._drop_strategy_markers(model, healthy_deployments)

13695:     def get_available_deployment(
13696:         self,
13697:         model: str,
13698:         messages: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None,
13699:         input: str | list | None = None,
13700:         specific_deployment: bool | None = False,
13701:         request_kwargs: dict | None = None,
13702:     ):
13703:         """
13704:         Returns the deployment based on routing strategy
13705:         """
13706:         if self.routing_plugins:
13707:             raise ValueError(
13708:                 "Router(plugins=[...]) is configured, but this call resolved to the synchronous "
13709:                 "deployment-selection path, which never runs the routing-plugin pipeline. This "
13710:                 "happens for sync Router methods (e.g. Router.completion()) and for async calls "
13711:                 "with a routing_strategy that has no async-native selector (e.g. legacy "
13712:                 "'usage-based-routing', v1). Silently skipping "
13713:                 "configured plugins would let a policy plugin (e.g. a deny-all rule) be bypassed. "
13714:                 "Use an async Router method with a supported routing_strategy (simple-shuffle, "
13715:                 "usage-based-routing-v2, cost-based-routing, latency-based-routing, least-busy), "
13716:                 "or remove `plugins` from the Router config."
13717:             )
13718:         # users need to explicitly call a specific deployment, by setting `specific_deployment = True` as completion()/embedding() kwarg
13719:         # When this was no explicit we had several issues with fallbacks timing out
13720: 
13721:         model, healthy_deployments = self._common_checks_available_deployment(
13722:             model=model,
13723:             messages=messages,
13724:             input=input,
13725:             specific_deployment=specific_deployment,
13726:             request_kwargs=request_kwargs,
13727:         )
13728:         strategy, strategy_selector = self._get_routing_context(model, request_kwargs)
13729: 
13730:         if isinstance(healthy_deployments, dict):
13731:             if (healthy_deployments.get("model_info") or {}).get("blocked") is True:
13732:                 raise litellm.ServiceUnavailableError(
13733:                     message=f"Model '{model}' is currently paused and cannot accept requests.",
13734:                     model=model,
13735:                     llm_provider="",
13736:                 )
13737:             self._override_selector_pre_call_check(strategy, strategy_selector, healthy_deployments)
13738:             return healthy_deployments
13739: 
13740:         parent_otel_span: Final[Span | None] = _get_parent_otel_span_from_kwargs(request_kwargs)
13741: 
13742:         # Health-check-based filtering (before cooldown)
13743:         healthy_deployments = self._filter_health_check_unhealthy_deployments(
13744:             healthy_deployments=healthy_deployments,
13745:             parent_otel_span=parent_otel_span,
13746:         )
13747: 
13748:         cooldown_deployments: Final = _get_cooldown_deployments(
13749:             litellm_router_instance=self, parent_otel_span=parent_otel_span
13750:         )
13751:         _pre_cooldown_deployments: Final = healthy_deployments
13752:         healthy_deployments = self._filter_cooldown_deployments(
13753:             healthy_deployments=healthy_deployments,
13754:             cooldown_deployments=cooldown_deployments,
13755:         )
13756:         if not healthy_deployments and self.enable_health_check_routing and self.allowed_fails_policy is not None:
13757:             verbose_router_logger.warning(
13758:                 "All deployments in cooldown via health-check routing, bypassing cooldown filter"
13759:             )
13760:             healthy_deployments = _pre_cooldown_deployments
13761: 
13762:         healthy_deployments = self._filter_blocked_deployments(healthy_deployments)
13763: 
13764:         # filter pre-call checks
13765:         if self.enable_pre_call_checks and (messages is not None or input is not None):
13766:             healthy_deployments = self._pre_call_checks(
13767:                 model=model,
13768:                 healthy_deployments=healthy_deployments,
13769:                 messages=messages,
13770:                 input=input,
13771:                 request_kwargs=request_kwargs,
13772:             )
13773: 
13774:         ## ORDER FILTERING ## -> if user set 'order' in deployments, return deployments with lowest order (e.g. order=1 > order=2)
13775:         _target_order: Final = (request_kwargs or {}).pop("_target_order", None)
13776:         healthy_deployments = litellm.utils.get_order_filtered_deployments(
13777:             healthy_deployments, target_order=_target_order
13778:         )
13779: 
13780:         ## WEIGHTED FAILOVER EXCLUSION ## -> drop deployments already tried in
13781:         ## this request via weighted-failover. See async counterpart in
13782:         ## async_get_healthy_deployments for details.
13783:         _excluded_deployment_ids: Final = (request_kwargs or {}).pop("_excluded_deployment_ids", None)
13784:         healthy_deployments = litellm.utils.get_excluded_filtered_deployments(
13785:             healthy_deployments,
13786:             excluded_deployment_ids=_excluded_deployment_ids,
13787:         )
13788: 
13789:         ## RETRY SKIP ## -> see async counterpart in async_get_healthy_deployments.
13790:         _retry_skipped_deployment_ids: Final = _as_retry_skipped_deployment_ids(
13791:             request_kwargs.pop("_retry_skipped_deployment_ids", None) if request_kwargs else None
13792:         )
13793:         healthy_deployments = (
13794:             litellm.utils.get_excluded_filtered_deployments(
13795:                 healthy_deployments, excluded_deployment_ids=_retry_skipped_deployment_ids
13796:             )
13797:             or healthy_deployments
13798:         )
13799: 
13800:         if len(healthy_deployments) == 0:
13801:             model_ids = self.get_model_ids(model_name=model)
13802:             _cooldown_time = self.cooldown_cache.get_min_cooldown(
13803:                 model_ids=model_ids, parent_otel_span=parent_otel_span
13804:             )
13805:             _cooldown_list = _get_cooldown_deployments(litellm_router_instance=self, parent_otel_span=parent_otel_span)
13806:             raise RouterRateLimitError(
13807:                 model=model,
13808:                 cooldown_time=_cooldown_time,
13809:                 enable_pre_call_checks=self.enable_pre_call_checks,
13810:                 cooldown_list=_cooldown_list,
13811:             )
13812: 
13813:         if strategy == "simple-shuffle":
13814:             # if users pass rpm or tpm, we do a random weighted pick - based on rpm/tpm
13815:             ############## Check 'weight' param set for weighted pick #################
13816:             return simple_shuffle(
13817:                 llm_router_instance=self,
13818:                 healthy_deployments=healthy_deployments,
13819:                 model=model,
13820:             )
13821:         deployment: Final = self._select_deployment_sync(
13822:             strategy=strategy,
13823:             selector=strategy_selector,
13824:             model=model,
13825:             healthy_deployments=healthy_deployments,
13826:             messages=messages,
13827:             input=input,
13828:             request_kwargs=request_kwargs,
13829:         )
13830: 
13831:         if deployment is None:
13832:             verbose_router_logger.info("get_available_deployment for model: %s, No deployment available", model)
13833:             model_ids = self.get_model_ids(model_name=model)
13834:             _cooldown_time = self.cooldown_cache.get_min_cooldown(
13835:                 model_ids=model_ids, parent_otel_span=parent_otel_span
13836:             )
13837:             _cooldown_list = _get_cooldown_deployments(litellm_router_instance=self, parent_otel_span=parent_otel_span)
13838:             raise RouterRateLimitError(
13839:                 model=model,
13840:                 cooldown_time=_cooldown_time,
13841:                 enable_pre_call_checks=self.enable_pre_call_checks,
13842:                 cooldown_list=_cooldown_list,
13843:             )
13844:         self._override_selector_pre_call_check(strategy, strategy_selector, deployment)
13845:         verbose_router_logger.info(
